title: A case where early rounding does not happen to move the total
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: The two approaches do not always disagree — here the per-amount rounding errors cancel out. That is what makes the habit dangerous: it passes most of the time, and only a specific mix of amounts, like three that each end in .125, exposes the cent it drops or adds.
